answer: Open bounty hunting resists Sybil attacks: the network pays a standing reward to anyone who proves an identity is fake, funded by slashing the fake stake, so every alias is a crystal-clear target - a prize, not a hiding place. Independent hunters act as a prism: one exposed fake refracts into evidence against its whole cluster - shared funding, timing, and counterparties. At the zenith of the hunt the economics flip: a thousand fakes carry a thousand bounties worth of risk, while one honest agent never attracts a claim.
